system.description: The Stormkelt summons an armor of storm flurries around himself or a chosen character. The armor provides a Protection Value of 2 against melee weapons and a Protection Value of 4 against ranged weapons. Against magical weapons, the Protection Value is 1 against melee weapons and 3 against ranged weapons.
